title: Vital Massothérapie
specs: Therapist is a professional dancer and choreographer with over 15 years experience
Therapist is a member of Regroupement des Massothérapeutes du Québec and Association des Naturothérapeutes du Québec
includes: Personalized treatment centered on listening to your discomforts and healing
Use of various massage techniques: Thai, Swedish, reflexology, polarity, cranial therapy, fasciatherapy
blurb: Guests receive personalized therapeutic massages including Thai, Swedish, reflexology, polarity therapy, cranial therapy, and fasciatherapy. Treatments focus on physical, psychological, emotional, and energetic harmony. The therapist uses a variety of somatic techniques and offers guidance for self-care exercises.
extraNote: Payment required at first meeting for Passeport santé package
